name: Pattaya

queries.query: Pattaya official cadastral parcel map GIS Thailand land department parcel viewer
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Department of Lands cadastral-map center/LandsMaps portal and a Pattaya city GIS report describing a land-parcel layer sourced from the Department of Lands. The Department of Lands portal was reachable; the LandsMaps map host did not complete an anonymous request in this environment.

queries.query: แผนที่โฉนดที่ดิน พัทยา กรมที่ดิน GIS แปลงที่ดิน
queries.result: Thai-language first-party discovery identified the same Department of Lands cadastral-map center and the Pattaya city GIS report. The report defines the land-parcel layer and says private parcel geometry is published by the Department of Lands; it identifies Parcel ID as a basic safe locating key. No city-operated anonymous polygon endpoint was evidenced.

researchNote: A local Pattaya government GIS report is evidence of a local city GIS custodian and documents land parcels, while the Department of Lands is the national cadastral data custodian. The public services were schema-inspected where reachable, but no bounded anonymous parcel polygon response was qualified. This packet is not source integration or runtime admission.
